title: Closing the panel crashes inside a lambda
summary: A Qt connect given only a lambda outlives its receiver. Pass this as the context object.

turns.user: closing the panel mid download crashes sometimes. stack trace says inside the progressChanged lambda

assistant.body: Got it. The culprit is the this the lambda holds. Without a context object, the connection lives on the Downloader side and survives the panel, so the lambda touches an m_label that is already freed. Pass this as the third argument and Qt drops the connection the moment the panel is destroyed.

turns.user: oh forgot to say, Downloader runs on its own thread. still fine?

assistant.body: Great question. The context actually makes it safer. The receiver lives on the GUI thread, so AutoConnection picks a queued connection and the lambda runs on the GUI thread. In other words, nothing touches QLabel from the worker thread any more, which the old code did on every update.
